@Nc.permanent_eq_coeff : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {C : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype C]
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq C] (M : Matrix C C R),
  M.permanent = MvPolynomial.coeff (Nc.ones C) (∏ i, ∑ j, MvPolynomial.C (M i j) * MvPolynomial.X j)
@Nc.mk_gadget : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {C : Type u_2} (h : R),
  h * 2 = 1 →
    ∀ (p q r s : C),
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Nc.sqIdeal R C))
          ((MvPolynomial.C h * MvPolynomial.X p + MvPolynomial.C h * MvPolynomial.X q +
                MvPolynomial.C h * MvPolynomial.X r -
              MvPolynomial.C h * MvPolynomial.X s) *
            (MvPolynomial.X p + MvPolynomial.X q - MvPolynomial.X r + MvPolynomial.X s)) =
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Nc.sqIdeal R C)) (MvPolynomial.X p * MvPolynomial.X q + MvPolynomial.X r * MvPolynomial.X s)
@Nc.slot_bijective : ∀ {N : Type u_1} [Fintype N] (σ ρ : Equiv.Perm N) (s r q : N → Bool),
  (Function.Bijective fun p => Nc.slot σ ρ p.1 (s p.1, r p.1, q p.1) p.2) ↔
    (∀ (n : N), s (σ n) = s n) ∧ (∀ (n : N), r (ρ n) = r n) ∧ ∀ (n : N), s (Nc.pick ρ r n) = q n
@Nc.gridMatrix_permanent : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {N : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype N]
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq N] (h : R),
  h * 2 = 1 →
    ∀ (σ ρ : Equiv.Perm N) (W : N → Bool → Bool → R),
      (Nc.gridMatrix h σ ρ W).permanent =
        ∑ s, ∑ r, if (∀ (n : N), s (σ n) = s n) ∧ ∀ (n : N), r (ρ n) = r n then ∏ n, W n (s n) (r n) else 0
@Nc.exists_grid : ∀ {N : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype N] [inst_1 : DecidableEq N] {R : Type u_3}
  [inst_2 : CommRing R] {K : Type u_4} [inst_3 : Fintype V] [inst_4 : DecidableEq V] [inst_5 : Fintype K]
  [inst_6 : DecidableEq K] (v : N → V) (w : N → K),
  Function.Surjective v →
    Function.Surjective w →
      ∃ σ ρ,
        (∀ (n : N), w (ρ n) = w n) ∧
          ∀ (h : R),
            h * 2 = 1 →
              ∀ (W : N → Bool → Bool → R), (Nc.gridMatrix h σ ρ W).permanent = ∑ x, ∑ r, ∏ n, W n (x (v n)) (r (w n))
@Nc.exists_permanent_fin : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {C : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype C]
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq C] (M : Matrix C C R) {S : ℕ},
  Fintype.card C ≤ S →
    ∃ M', M'.permanent = M.permanent ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin S), (M' i j = 0 ∨ M' i j = 1) ∨ ∃ c d, M' i j = M c d
@Paper.prop_grid : ∀ {R : Type} [inst : CommRing R] (h : R),
  h * 2 = 1 →
    ∀ {N V K : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] [inst_3 : Fintype V] [inst_4 : DecidableEq V]
      [inst_5 : Fintype K] [inst_6 : DecidableEq K] (v : N → V) (w : N → K),
      Function.Surjective v →
        Function.Surjective w →
          ∀ (W : N → Bool → Bool → R) {S : ℕ},
            3 * Fintype.card N ≤ S →
              ∃ M,
                (∀ (i j : Fin S), Paper.GridEntry h w W (M i j)) ∧ M.permanent = ∑ x, ∑ r, ∏ n, W n (x (v n)) (r (w n))
@Paper.gridComplete_perm : ∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F], 2 ≠ 0 → Nc.GridComplete F (Nc.genPerm F) 3
@Paper.cor_clauses : ∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F],
  2 ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {ι V K : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype V] [inst_2 : DecidableEq V] [inst_3 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
      (lits : K → List (V × Bool)),
      (∀ (κ : K), lits κ ≠ []) →
        (∀ (b : V), ∃ κ, ∃ l ∈ lits κ, l.1 = b) →
          ∀ (wt : K → MvPolynomial ι F),
            (∀ (κ : K), (∃ i, wt κ = MvPolynomial.X i) ∨ ∃ a, wt κ = MvPolynomial.C a) →
              ∀ {S : ℕ},
                3 * ∑ κ, (lits κ).length ≤ S →
                  ∃ M, (∀ (i j : Fin S), Nc.IsAffine (M i j)) ∧ M.permanent = Paper.clauseSum lits wt
@Nc.Computes.aeval : ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] {ι : Type u_2} {κ : Type u_3} {p : MvPolynomial κ F} {s : ℕ},
  Nc.Computes p s →
    ∀ (E : κ → MvPolynomial ι F), (∀ (k : κ), Nc.IsAffine (E k)) → Nc.Computes ((MvPolynomial.aeval E) p) (5 * s)
